title: Uniform finite-periodic single-character Duhamel remainder
question: Does the exact finite Gibbs-isometric Duhamel remainder theorem combine with the EXP-001069 static character envelope to give a uniform remainder bound for one local configuration character across the registered finite periodic Q3 family?

model.scope: Registered finite periodic Q3 volumes at fixed beta, compact onsite sources and one local configuration character W_a; no products, split histories, arbitrary boundaries or thermodynamic promotion.
model.finite_theorem: R_t(X)=integral_0^t (t-s) alpha_s(delta_H^2(X)) ds and Gibbs isometry gives N_beta(R_t(X))<=t^2*N_beta(delta_H^2(X))/2 for each finite Gibbs member.
model.static_input: EXP-001069 supplies N_rho(delta_H^2(W_a))^2<=B_static uniformly in the registered static family.
model.uniformity: The displayed bound is uniform only for the registered single-character finite periodic family and its declared source/parameter fixture.

scope.not_closed: This package closes only a uniform finite-periodic remainder estimate for one local character. It does not establish a product class, split-history factorial bound, direct D or delta-D Cauchy theorem, exhaustion-independent dynamics, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

adversarial_review.check: The Duhamel identity is used only for each finite Gibbs member, where the Gibbs seminorm isometry is exact.
Squaring the t^2/2 bound gives t^4/4; the time factor is recomputed from the fixture rather than pasted.
The EXP-001069 envelope is reused as a static bound and is not silently applied to evolved split histories.
Only W_a is covered; no product or generated algebra density claim is made.
The finite theorem applies per orientation; no plus/minus Gibbs carrier identification is asserted.
Uniformity is restricted to the declared periodic compact-source static family and does not become an all-exhaustion theorem.
R252 checks rational time scaling and the conservative envelope only; it does not formalize unbounded generators or limits.
Direct D/delta-D, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

qft_interface.closed: A uniform finite-periodic Taylor remainder envelope is obtained for one local character from the static full second-commutator bound.
qft_interface.open: Products, split histories, direct D and delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing single-character finite-periodic Duhamel corollary; not a dynamics completion.
next_action: Extend the remainder estimate to a preregistered product/core class only after an evolved-force and modular-domain estimate is proved; otherwise record the exact history obstruction.
no_overclaim: This is a finite QFT-facing single-character remainder checkpoint. It is not a product-class dynamics theorem, an OS reconstruction, a KMS/GNS result, a mass-gap proof, a continuum result, a C6/Sector-A/Pre-A result, a TECT production map or a Clay result.
